resources.label: The Vague Prompt
resources.instruction: Open Claude in a new tab. Copy and paste this prompt and run it. Read the output.
resources.content: Why did the moon mission fail?
resources.note: Notice how generic and unfocused the response is. This is your Minion with no guidance.

resources.label: The Good Prompt
resources.instruction: Now copy and paste this structured prompt in the same chat and run it. Compare the two outputs.
resources.content:
You are a data-driven mission analyst.

GRU's moon heist failed after Vector stole the shrink ray mid-mission. The operation had a solid plan but collapsed at the execution stage. The team of 12 Minions was well equipped but the mission had no contingency plan when the primary objective was compromised.

Analyze why the moon mission failed and identify the 3 key lessons GRU must apply to avoid the same mistakes on the next mission.

Present as a numbered list. Each lesson gets a name, one sentence explanation, and one specific action GRU should take differently.

Be direct and specific. Focus only on actionable lessons. Avoid repeating the same point in different words.

breakdown.highlight: You are a data-driven mission analyst.
breakdown.explanation: Tells the AI who to be. Changes how it thinks, not just what it says.

breakdown.highlight: GRU's moon heist failed after Vector stole the shrink ray mid-mission...
breakdown.explanation: Gives the AI the background it needs. Without this, every answer is generic.

breakdown.highlight: Analyze why the moon mission failed and identify the 3 key lessons...
breakdown.explanation: Tells the AI exactly what to do. Specific tasks produce specific results.

breakdown.highlight: Present as a numbered list. Each lesson gets a name, one sentence explanation, and one specific action...
breakdown.explanation: Designs the output shape before asking the question. Format determines usability.

breakdown.highlight: Be direct and specific. Focus only on actionable lessons. Avoid repeating the same point in different words.
breakdown.explanation: Sets the rules. Boundaries produce precision.

resources.note: Same Minion. Same topic. Completely different output. That is the power of a structured prompt.

resources.label: L0 - Raw Ask
resources.concept_intro: Everyone starts here. You type the question the way you would say it out loud - no structure, no thought about the answer you actually want. Run it once so you have something to measure against. Every layer from here earns its place by beating this.

try_prompt.instruction: Open a new chat and run this. This is your baseline.
try_prompt.content: How do I steal the sun?

resources.label: L1 - Task
resources.concept_intro: A vague question gets a vague answer. Say exactly what you want back: how many, of what, by when. This one change usually does more for output quality than anything else on this page.
resources.added_highlight: Give me 3 plans for Operation: Steal the Sun, executed within 6 months.

try_prompt.instruction: Replace the question with a precise ask. Run it and compare to L0.
try_prompt.content: Give me 3 plans for Operation: Steal the Sun, executed within 6 months.
try_prompt.what_changed: A vague question became a specific deliverable: how many plans (3), which mission, and the deadline (6 months).

resources.label: L2 - Role
resources.concept_intro: Tell Claude who to be before you tell it what to do. A role changes which knowledge it reaches for and what it treats as obvious. A strategist and a helpful assistant answer the same question very differently.
resources.added_highlight: You are a veteran super-villain strategist with 30 years of audacious-heist experience and a working knowledge of orbital mechanics. You design theatrical but technically achievable plans, in the spirit of the Moon Heist (2010).

try_prompt.instruction: Add the role above your ask. Run it and compare to L1.
try_prompt.content:
You are a veteran super-villain strategist with 30 years of audacious-heist experience and a working knowledge of orbital mechanics. You design theatrical but technically achievable plans, in the spirit of the Moon Heist (2010).

Give me 3 plans for Operation: Steal the Sun, executed within 6 months.
try_prompt.what_changed: Added an expert identity with real specifics - years of experience, orbital mechanics, a signature style. Vague roles like 'you are an expert' change nothing.

resources.label: L3 - Context
resources.concept_intro: Claude knows a great deal about the world and nothing at all about yours. Your team, your limits, your history, what already failed. This is the layer that turns a good generic answer into one written for your actual situation.
resources.added_highlight: I am Chief Strategist of 1inMINION. I run a lab with 400 Minions - enthusiastic but easily distracted by bananas. The Anti-Villain League is watching. In 2010 I stole the Moon but returned it for my daughters. Vector is racing me to the Sun. The Sun is 5,500 degrees C - handling protocols matter. Any plan must be quiet, school-night-friendly, and conclude before bedtime.

try_prompt.instruction: Add the background about your world. Run it and compare to L2.
try_prompt.content:
You are a veteran super-villain strategist with 30 years of audacious-heist experience and a working knowledge of orbital mechanics. You design theatrical but technically achievable plans, in the spirit of the Moon Heist (2010).

I am Chief Strategist of 1inMINION. I run a lab with 400 Minions - enthusiastic but easily distracted by bananas. The Anti-Villain League is watching. In 2010 I stole the Moon but returned it for my daughters. Vector is racing me to the Sun. The Sun is 5,500 degrees C - handling protocols matter. Any plan must be quiet, school-night-friendly, and conclude before bedtime.

Give me 3 plans for Operation: Steal the Sun, executed within 6 months.
try_prompt.what_changed: Added who we are, what we tried before, who is competing, and the physical limits we cannot argue with. The plans now answer for this lab, not any lab.

resources.label: L4 - Output Format
resources.concept_intro: Decide what the answer should look like before you ask for it. A brilliant plan buried in six paragraphs is still work you have to do yourself. Shape the output around how you will actually use it.
resources.added_highlight: Format as a table with columns: Plan Name | Capture Method | Minion Count Needed | Difficulty (1-5) | Estimated Time | Daughter-Approved? Add a one-line why this could work under each row.

try_prompt.instruction: Add your format instruction. Run it and compare to L3.
try_prompt.content:
You are a veteran super-villain strategist with 30 years of audacious-heist experience and a working knowledge of orbital mechanics. You design theatrical but technically achievable plans, in the spirit of the Moon Heist (2010).

I am Chief Strategist of 1inMINION. I run a lab with 400 Minions - enthusiastic but easily distracted by bananas. The Anti-Villain League is watching. In 2010 I stole the Moon but returned it for my daughters. Vector is racing me to the Sun. The Sun is 5,500 degrees C - handling protocols matter. Any plan must be quiet, school-night-friendly, and conclude before bedtime.

Give me 3 plans for Operation: Steal the Sun, executed within 6 months.

Format as a table with columns: Plan Name | Capture Method | Minion Count Needed | Difficulty (1-5) | Estimated Time | Daughter-Approved? Add a one-line why this could work under each row.
try_prompt.what_changed: Named the exact structure - a table, the specific columns, and a one-line justification per row. The answer is now scannable and comparable.

resources.label: L5 - Constraints
resources.concept_intro: The rules the answer has to live inside: budget, tone, length, what is off the table. Good prompting is as much about saying no as saying yes. Constraints are what separate an interesting idea from one you can actually act on.
resources.added_highlight:
Constraints:
- Total budget under 50M
- No permanent damage to Earth - my daughters live here
- No weaponized freeze rays - the AVL is monitoring those
- Global average temperature must not drop more than 2 degrees during the operation
- Keep each plan description under 40 words
- Tone: professional villain memo, not cartoonish
